title: ヴィクトリアマイルの後に・前へ

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: I ran my absolute best, and I don't think I need to tell you that it was thanks to everyone's support! I feel like the crowd's cheers are getting a teensy bit louder each race.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: And that's not all! City came to watch me too! She said that I've really changed!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: But then she asked me how I did it… how I could be so bold in the face of so many challenges. She didn't seem like herself…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: It seems like even the greats have stuff they worry about. Anyway, I should really focus on myself right now!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: My next goal's the Queen Elizabeth II Cup! The Miho dorm leader (and my good friend!) Hishiama might be running, which means I've gotta give it my best!
